body:
PUPPET SOLDIER
CR 6

XP 2,400
N Medium construct
Init +1, Senses blindsense 60 ft., Perception +10

DEFENSE

AC 19, touch 11, flat-footed 18 (+1 Dex, +8 natural)
hp 66 (8d10 +20) (30 hp strings)
Fort +2, Ref +3, Will +2; DR 10/adamantine; Immune construct traits, magic

OFFENSE

Speed 25 ft.
Melee longsword +12/+7 (2d8+4 slashing plus bind)

STATISTICS

Str 18, Dex 13, Con -, Int -, Wis -, Cha –
Base Atk +8; CMB +13, CMD 19, immune to trip

SPECIAL ABILITIES

On a String (Ex)

The strings of these puppets can be attacked. It has the same armor class as the puppet, but has no damage reduction. If the strings are brought to zero hit points, the puppet dies instantly. The strings are vulnerable to slashing damage, and immune to bludgeoning. They have standard object immunities.

Hard to Kill (Ex)

Puppet soldiers do not die at zero hit points. If the body is brought to zero hit points, it is instead put to 50 hit points, as most of the armor breaks. All of its rolls are at -4 when this occurs. If a puppet’s body is brought to 0 hit points while in this state, it dies.

Bind (Ex)

A creature struck by a puppet soldier’s longs word must make a Reflex save DC 13. If it fails, the creature is bound in strings, giving it the grappled condition. This persists until the creature uses a standard action to make a DC 13 Strength check or Escape Artist check to break out.
